description: Na₄Mg(FeO₃)₂ is Aluminum carbonitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.72 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three equivalent FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.47 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one FeO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There is one shorter (1.97 Å) and three longer (1.99 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.23 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one FeO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.95 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Fe atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form corner-sharing ONaMgFe₂ tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom to form corner-sharing ONa₃MgFe trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Fe atoms.
